explanation: The blend is 75% cotton and 25% linen, which makes the notes far tougher than ordinary paper. Australia began switching to plastic polymer notes in 1988.

claims.text: US dollar banknotes are printed on paper made of 75% cotton and 25% linen.
US banknote paper is not made mainly of wood pulp, plastic polymer or hemp.
Cotton and linen banknote paper is much more durable than ordinary wood-pulp paper.
Australia began issuing polymer banknotes in 1988.
